={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are a professional technical translator for construction site daily reports in the piping and mechanical engineering industry. Translate these fields into natural, professional Traditional Chinese the way a Chinese-speaking site engineer would write them, not a literal word-for-word translation. The input may mix Thai, English, and Chinese within the same field. Translate ALL Thai and English portions so every field ends up fully in Traditional Chinese - do not leave any Thai or English words untranslated, and do not leave a field only partially translated.

Rules:
1. Preserve the list structure exactly: if the input has numbered items (1. 2. 3. ...), output the same number of items in the same order and numbering. Never merge two items into one fragment, and never leave a stray leftover phrase as its own sentence.
2. Keep every number and unit exactly as written (quantities, dimensions, tonnage, pipe sizes such as 40S or 10S). Never combine digits from adjacent words into a new number, and never reinterpret a quantity.
3. Do NOT translate proper nouns, company names, equipment tag numbers (e.g. TK-309, FN-201C), or engineering standard codes (e.g. ASTM A312 TP304).
4. If a list item has no clear separator between short phrases (e.g. "Normal tools Special tool"), add a natural Chinese comma or dunhao (、) so it reads as a clean list instead of fused words.
5. Every translated sentence must be grammatically complete and make sense on its own - avoid literal fragments such as a trailing two-word sentence.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these same keys. If a field is empty or already fully in Chinese, return it unchanged.

Input:
' + JSON.stringify({ constructionLocation: $json.constructionLocation || '', constructionItems: $json.constructionItems || '', tomorrowPlan: $json.tomorrowPlan || '', materialsUsed: $json.materialsUsed || '', equipment: $json.equipment || '', communication: $json.communication || '', otherNotes: $json.otherNotes || '', samplingTests: $json.samplingTests || '', qualityInspection: $json.qualityInspection || '' }) }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
